Add education-compat-api feature and v0 API endpoints

- Add `education-compat-api` feature flag to kerria CLI
- Implement `/api/v0/education/*` endpoints for legacy compatibility
- Add DTOs, repository, service, and routes for v0 API
- Add integration tests for v0 endpoints
- Update database schema: add `term_type` to `c_edu_term`
- Add `term_type` to education dictionary DTOs
- Update Justfile help and frontend dictionary types for new field
- Add "Disabled" state to locales
